UnitStatement: Chirality is a governed, filesystem-native agent operating system for deliverable-heavy professional work.
The repository is the private canonical source tree for Chirality.

The repository holds shared instruction architecture, governance documents, a deterministic tool layer, public-export source surface, private project workspaces, domain workspaces, and export tooling for the sanitized public chirality-app package.
When the filesystem is the database, architecture is a state-and-authority specification rather than a service mesh.
Chirality is not an autonomous swarm.
Chirality directs AI agents through an instruction architecture, tool layer, and desktop harness.
Chirality uses explicit scope, evidence, write-boundary, snapshot, and human-gate rules for agent direction.
AI can accelerate professional work but cannot inherit professional responsibility.
The private repository is upstream of the public chirality-app export.
The private repository is maintained as a canonical source tree for related but distinct surfaces.
Instruction and governance roots include AGENTS.md, agents/, docs/, and root framework docs.
Instruction and governance changes should use live registries and governance docs rather than historical inventories.
Skills and tools are rooted in skills/ and tools/.
Method logic belongs in skills and deterministic operations belong in tools.
The public export surface consists of exports/chirality-app/ and export-allowed root files and directories.
The export profile is the public boundary contract.
Next app development belongs in projects/chirality-app-dev/.
The root frontend/ directory is kept as the exported harness snapshot.
projects/ and domains/ are private applied or development workspaces unless a separate export path is created.
.archive/ should be treated as historical context.
plans/ should be treated as non-governing planning material unless a file declares active draft status.
The shared operating-system surface has a prescribed maintainer orientation path.
The deeper rationale is located in CHIRALITY_FRAMEWORK.md, PROFESSIONAL_ENGINEERING.md, and docs/thesis/.
Private project context should be read from local README/docs inside the relevant workspace instead of promoted into root docs.
The root operating-system surface is the canonical shared surface.
AGENTS.md contains the agent matrix, live agent index, governance integration rules, and canonical dispatch relationships.
agents/ contains individual agent instruction contracts.
skills/ contains repo-native method packs loaded by TASK.
tools/ contains deterministic helpers, validators, build/reporting utilities, and the curated tool registry.
docs/ contains Chirality-wide governance, specifications, roadmap, design basis, and thesis context.
examples/ contains sanitized example workspaces and artifacts included in the public export.
frontend/ is the public-exported runtime harness snapshot, not the private app-development source.
init/ contains bootstrap and next-session notes.
exports/ contains private export profiles, manifests, and reports.
projects/ contains private project-local development workspaces.
domains/ contains private/manual domain packs and local corpus shells.
plans/ is a planning workspace for archival imports and active draft plans not yet governed roadmap authority.
.archive/ contains local archived migration and historical material.
Root-level framing documents provide the theoretical and professional-practice basis for Chirality.
Chirality separates the instruction root from the working root.
The instruction root contains release-managed instructions, governance documents, skills, tools, and bootstrap files.
The working root is the user-selected project filesystem where agents read and write governed state.
Authoritative project state is file-based.
Packages, deliverables, references, dependency registers, review records, snapshots, and publication outputs are readable as plain files.
Authoritative project files are readable by humans, agents, and deterministic tools.
Runtime convenience state may exist in the harness.
Chat context, model memory, browser storage, local UI preferences, and application caches do not override governed project files.
Decisions not recorded in a versioned file do not exist for purposes of reliance.
Chirality is designed around the problem that model output can sound plausible while unsupported.
The system response is to make warrant, authority, and uncertainty visible.
Governed claims require mandatory provenance.
Unknowns require explicit TBD markers.
Conflicts should be surfaced instead of silently resolved.
Epistemic labels include FACT, ASSUMPTION, PROPOSAL, and TBD.
Human authority remains non-transferable.
Agents can propose, extract, draft, reconcile, validate, and report.
Humans decide, approve, adjudicate conflicts, accept residual risk, and issue work for reliance.
No agent may certify, approve, sign, seal, or issue professional work product.
The invariant system is defined in docs/CONTRACT.md.
The design basis and professional grounding are developed in docs/DBM_Agent_Instruction_Architecture.md, CHIRALITY_FRAMEWORK.md, and PROFESSIONAL_ENGINEERING.md.
Live registries and discovery tools should be used rather than static counts.
Agent sources are AGENTS.md and agents/AGENT_*.md.
Skill sources are skills/README.md plus immediate skills/*/SKILL.md folders.
Tool sources use tools/REGISTRY.md as the curated contract and index surface.
Test discovery for the private canonical repo uses tools/validation/discover_test_surfaces.py.
Roadmap authority is docs/PLAN.md.
Agents are instruction contracts that specify role, authority, write scope, interaction surface, protocol, and output expectations.
The Type 0 / Type 1 / Type 2 model is an authority model.
The matrix in AGENTS.md is a governance and routing view.
TASK is the canonical bounded Type 2 execution shell.
Skills are method packs that TASK can hydrate for recurring task shapes.

Tools are deterministic helpers for repeatable operations including scaffolding, validation, PDF/drawing processing, dependency analysis, publication assembly, source cataloging, and test-surface discovery.
Maintainer changes should target the smallest authoritative surface that owns the behavior.
Agent role, authority, or routing changes go through AGENTS.md and agents/.
Recurring bounded method changes go through skills/ and require skill metadata validation.
Deterministic behavior changes go through tools/.
tools/REGISTRY.md must be updated when a deterministic tool contract is part of the curated index.
Chirality-wide governance changes go through root docs/, not project-local docs.
App and product development changes happen in projects/chirality-app-dev/ before reviewed public-export material is promoted into root or export surfaces.
OpenPipeStress or domain-pack material should be changed in its project or domain workspace by default.
OpenPipeStress or domain-pack material should not be backfilled into root docs by default.
The public export manifest must be regenerated after any public-exported file changes.
When live folders, indexes, and narrative documents disagree, live registry or discovery surfaces are the starting point.
Discrepancies between live folders, indexes, and narrative documents should be surfaced in the change.
projects/ and domains/ are private canonical-repo workspaces.
projects/ and domains/ are not part of the public chirality-app export.
projects/chirality-app-dev/ is the current private development pathway for the next Chirality App version.
projects/chirality-app-dev/ contains project-local docs, execution material, examples, plans, provenance, and frontend source.
The current projects/chirality-app-dev/ state should be treated as draft or pre-release development material.
projects/chirality-piping/ is the OpenPipeStress project-local workspace.
OpenPipeStress is a code-neutral piping flexibility and stress-analysis platform.
OpenPipeStress has project-local governance, docs, schemas, code, apps, tests, validation assets, execution material, plans, and provenance.
The OpenPipeStress project tree is private to the canonical repo and is not exported through chirality-app.
domains/piping-design/ is a private/manual domain pack for piping-design knowledge, decomposition state, vocabulary roots, local source corpora, and local indexes.
Large corpora and generated local indexes in domains/piping-design/ are intentionally excluded from git and public export.
root frontend/ is the public-exported runtime harness snapshot.
The public chirality-app package can operate the instruction architecture against a selected project root through root frontend/.
Future Chirality App product and frontend development should be oriented around projects/chirality-app-dev/.
root frontend/ implementation details should not be treated as the long-term architecture contract.
The durable source of truth is the instruction, governance, skill, tool, export, and project-development surface described in the README.
The public chirality-app export is controlled by exports/chirality-app/.
The current public export profile includes the shared operating-system surface needed by the app package.
The public export profile includes root governance, bootstrap, and framing files.
The public export profile includes .github/.
The public export profile includes AGENTS.md.
The public export profile includes agents/.
The public export profile includes skills/.
The public export profile includes tools/.
The public export profile includes docs/.
The public export profile includes examples/.
The public export profile includes frontend/.
The public export profile includes init/.
The current public export profile excludes private or local-only workspace content.
The public export profile excludes .archive/.
The public export profile excludes projects/.
The public export profile excludes domains/.
The public export profile excludes plans/.
The public export profile excludes exports/.
The public export profile excludes migration records.
The public export profile excludes source corpora and local indexes.
The public export profile excludes dependency, build, and cache folders.
The public export profile excludes local runtime state.
The public export profile excludes environment files and secrets.
Public package contents must not be inferred from the root directory listing.
The export profile is the boundary for copied content.
Some exported tools and docs may mention canonical private workspace paths because they are maintained from the source tree.
Mentions of canonical private workspace paths in exported tools and docs do not mean private workspace content is exported.
The public staging package is built by running python3 exports/chirality-app/export_public.py.
The export profile copies allowlisted files.
The export profile sanitizes private absolute paths in text files.
The export profile writes the export manifest and report.
The export profile fails if boundary checks find forbidden public paths or private absolute path leaks.
A local public checkout can be replaced after reviewing the staging report using export_public.py --apply-target.
.archive/ is local archived material.
Moved migration records under .archive/migration/ are useful for understanding how the canonical repo was assembled.
Moved migration records are not live inventory, current topology, or part of the public export.
plans/ is a planning workspace.
Most plans/ material is archival or draft context.
plans/ may hold active planning seeds before promotion into governed roadmap authority.
The governed roadmap surface remains docs/PLAN.md.
Validation checks should be selected based on the change.
Skill metadata validation should run after skill changes.
Test discovery should run when changing test surfaces or reporting available checks.
The export tool should run before publishing or after changing any public-exported surface.
Chirality uses the MIT License plus Professional Engineering Clause.
The 2026 Ryan Tufts copyright notice is copyright matter rather than domain decomposition content.
Notes: Copyright matter is classified OUT per skill guidance.
